segments.name: Mineral exploration
segments.description: An emerging Canadian gold producer exploring and delineating gold resources on two material properties in Newfoundland and Labrador.
segments.evidence: New Found Gold is an emerging Canadian gold producer with assets in the Province of Newfoundland and Labrador.

changes.text: In 2025, New Found Gold acquired all shares of Maritime Resources Corp. it did not already own, making Maritime a fully owned subsidiary and adding the Hammerdown Gold Project.
changes.evidence: Effective November 13, 2025, New Found Gold acquired all of the issued and outstanding shares of Maritime Resources Corp. (" Maritime "), a company incorporated under the laws of British Columbia, that it did not already own by way of a statutory plan of arrangement pursuant to Division 5 of Part 9 of the BCBCA, whereby Maritime became its fully owned subsidiary.
